text: Simmer kombu in 1 litre of water for 10 minutes, then remove.
Add sliced shiitake and simmer for 8 minutes.
Cook buckwheat noodles separately and rinse.
Stir in kale until wilted, then turn off the heat.
Dissolve miso and tamari in a ladle of broth and stir back in.
Serve over noodles, topped with sesame seeds.
Cook wild rice according to the packet.
Roast cubed beets at 200°C for 30 minutes.
Massage kale with a pinch of salt.
Warm the adzuki beans with tamari.
Assemble bowls and finish with sesame seeds and blueberries.
Simmer lentils for 20 minutes until tender, then drain.
Lightly steam broccoli florets and sliced zucchini for 4 minutes.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil and chopped parsley.
Toss everything together and top with pumpkin seeds and sauerkraut.
Cook oats with water or plant milk for 5 minutes.
Stir in ground flaxseeds.
Top with orange segments, pomegranate and cashew butter.
Rinse and cook quinoa for 15 minutes.
Season salmon with turmeric and sear 4 minutes per side.
Quickly grill asparagus and sliced pepper.
Serve on spinach with quinoa and chopped almonds.
Simmer amaranth in coconut milk and water for 20 minutes.
Stir until creamy.
Top with berries, chopped pistachios and chocolate.
Heat oven to 200°C.
Toss cubed sweet potato, cauliflower, chickpeas and garlic with oil and salt.
Roast for 30 minutes, turning once.
Cook brown rice meanwhile.
Serve with watercress and a tahini drizzle.
Sauté onion, leek and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add cubed pumpkin and stock, simmer 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth and season.
Top with toasted sunflower seeds.
Rinse buckwheat and simmer in plant milk with a pinch of salt for 15 minutes.
Stir in half of the berries and let them burst.
Top with remaining berries and toasted seeds.
Simmer barley for 25 minutes until tender.
Season chicken with lemon zest, salt and oil; pan-fry 6 minutes per side.
Add artichokes and peas to the pan for the last 3 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice and chopped parsley; serve over barley.
Rinse lentils and simmer with turmeric and chopped tomatoes for 15 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk and cook 5 more minutes.
Fold in spinach until wilted and top with sliced scallions.
Toast millet in a dry pan, then simmer in 300 ml water for 20 minutes.
Bake sliced apple and pear with cinnamon at 190°C for 15 minutes.
Serve millet topped with baked fruit, chopped dates and walnuts.
